The uncompromising code formatter.

Usage: black [OPTIONS] [SRC]...

Options:
  -l, --line-length INTEGER  How many characters per line [default: 88]
  -t, --target-version [py37]  Target Python version for code syntax [default: py33]
  -S, --skip-string-normalization Don't normalize string quotes or prefixes
  -c, --check               Don't write back, only check
  -q, --quiet               Don't emit progress messages
  -v, --verbose             Emit debugging information
  --diff                    Don't write, output diffs instead
  --color                   Show colored diff
  -r, --line-ranges LINE_RANGE  When reformatting, limit to these line ranges
  -h, --help                Show this message and exit
